description: This file defines the Config struct for AI/LLM API configuration, including default values and environment variable overrides. It provides methods for validating the configuration and checking if the configuration targets OpenRouter.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for AI/LLM API calls such as API key, base URL, model, temperature, max tokens, and timeout.

methods.name: DefaultConfig
methods.description: Creates a default Config instance, reading environment variables for customization, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks if the configuration fields are properly set, such as ensuring APIKey, BaseURL, and Model are non-empty.

methods.name: IsOpenRouter
methods.description: Determines whether the current configuration targets the OpenRouter API based on the BaseURL.
